verdict.rationale: Alloy is a SaaS identity and fraud-decisioning platform. Whether its source is available under an open license is a fair question for this kind of product, so the axis applies. Nothing in the evidence says any Alloy source code, including the SDK, is published under an open license; the SDK mention says nothing about licensing or source availability.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can read the product's source under an open license
